correctness.rationale: Conditioning on eight possible initial-positive four-step sign words and reflecting signs gives exact conditional K4=2 values (0,0,u,v,v−u,3/8−v,1/4,1/2−v). The independent difference-pair symmetry for iid continuous magnitudes yields the 3/8,1/8 identities. Weights q^e(1−q)^{3−e} cancel the auxiliary u and produce a(q)=(5q³−3q²+3q+3)/16 and b(q,v)=(1−q)(3−4q+5q²)/8 + v(1−q)²(2q−1); full law is (a,(1−2a−b)/2,b,(1−2a−b)/2,a). Direct sign-word reasoning gives n<=3 law. Reflection, event disjointness (v<1/3), and continuous log-uniform-family interpolation yield sharp attainable v in [0,1/3), endpoint 1/3 excluded. Uniform(1,3/2) v=0 and exponential v=1/4 are explicit witnesses. Independent 500000-path Monte Carlo for each of 10 (q,magnitude-law) combinations agreed in all five probabilities to 0.0014, complementing rather than proving exact event argument.
